$$
u(x, t) = \frac{4}{\pi^3} e^{-2\pi^2 t} \sin(\pi x) + \frac{4}{27\pi^3} e^{-18\pi^2 t} \sin(3\pi x) + \frac{4}{125\pi^3} e^{-50\pi^2 t} \sin(5\pi x) + \frac{4}{343\pi^3} e^{-98\pi^2 t} \sin(7\pi x) + \frac{4}{729\pi^3} e^{-162\pi^2 t} \sin(9\pi x)
$$
